methodology.target: Diagnostic differences relative to the five-minute link-speed proxy O, not measured trajectory or exhaust truth.
methodology.S_pred: D*(Tf+wbar_hat)*r0(L/(Tf+wbar_hat)); same predicted count, distance, VHT as M.
methodology.mean_correction_admissibility: 0<vq_hat<vf and 0<=wbar_observed<=L*(1/vq_hat-1/vf). No clamping; invalid cases excluded from counterfactual scores.
methodology.profile_admissibility: Stricter optional profile: peak_corrected=wbar_observed/theta; peak_corrected<=bound; nonnegative reconstructed arrivals with fixed P_hat/theta.
methodology.exact_M_decomposition: M-O = D*(wbar_hat-wbar_observed)*Gamma_hat + (M_mean_corrected-O). The latter includes rate allocation and queue-speed estimation, not pure emission approximation.
methodology.same_observed_time_chord_identity: M_mean_corrected-S = H_obs*[linear rate chord through (vq_hat,rq),(vf,rf) at v_obs-r0(v_obs)]. Applicable only to mean-admissible counterfactual.
methodology.caution: Signed accounting differences depend on the specified counterfactual and order. They are not independent causal effects; absolute errors and WAPE components do not add.
